#STATUS CODE 
200 OK
Meaning: Request successful
Use case: Data fetched, login success, update success

201 Created
Meaning: New resource created
Use case: Signup, create product, create order

400 Bad Request
Meaning: Request is wrong/incomplete
Use case: Missing email/password/name

401 Unauthorized
Meaning: User is not authenticated
Use case: No token, invalid token, expired token, wrong password

403 Forbidden
Meaning: User is authenticated but not allowed
Use case: Normal user accessing admin route

404 Not Found
Meaning: Requested thing does not exist
Use case: User/product/order/route not found

409 Conflict
Meaning: Request conflicts with existing data
Use case: Email already exists, username already taken

422 Validation Error
Meaning: Data is present but rules failed
Use case: Weak password, invalid email, age below allowed limit

429 Too Many Requests
Meaning: Too many requests
Use case: Rate limiting, too many login attempts, too many OTP requests

500 Server Error
Meaning: Backend/server/database failed
Use case: Database crashed, unexpected code error
